Name: (CP) Unique Flower Dance Outfits
Author: seraphony
Description:
Ever notice how the Flower Dance sprites look copy/pasted? Maru's skin is desaturated, Emily is several pixels shorter than usual...etc. Well, this mod aims to not only fix that, but also give each of the characters their own style!

I did thorough testing on each sprite, but if you notice any issues or bugs, please let me know! This is my first time creating a mod for any game and I'm not familiar with JSON, nor am I very familiar with pixel art.
---
[i]I do not currently plan on making mod compatibilities, but this may change in the future.[/i]
